ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(No_Known_Contact__c = FALSE, OR( Customer_Contact_Name__c = "", Customer_Contact_Email__c = "", Customer_Contact_Title_Designation__c = "", ISBLANK(TEXT(Customer_Contact_Level__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Customer_Contact_Department__c))), NOT( OR( ISCHANGED(Opportunity_Open__c), ISCHANGED(Opportunities__c), ISCHANGED(Opportunity_Closed_Lost__c), ISCHANGED(Opportunity_Closed_Won__c), ISCHANGED(Opportunity_Total__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: All Customer Contact Fields are required unless No Known Contact is marked as true
